List of Razakars will be published within December: minister
2023-04-25T23:27:27+06:00 | BSS, Sylhet
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/list-razakars-will-be-published-within-december-minister-3304406

Liberation War Affairs Minister AKM Mozammel Huq today said a list of Razakars (Pakistani collaborators), who committed crimes against humanity during the 1971 Liberation War, will be published within December this year.

The minister said this while talking to journalists after visiting the shrine of Hazrat Shahjalal (RA) in Sylhet this afternoon.

Recently, Jatiya Sangsad passed a law in this regard, he said.

A committee headed by Chairman of the Parliamentary Standing Committee of Ministry of Liberation War Affairs Shajahan Khan has been formed to make the list, he added.
